case.question: How long is the graduate permission for a level 9 masters degree

result.question: How long is the graduate permission for a level 9 masters degree
result.answer:
Graduates with an award at Level 9 or above on the National Framework of Qualifications who qualify for the Programme will be granted permission for 12 months initially [1]. This will be renewed for a further period of twelve months (subject to the overall eight year limit on student conditions not being exceeded) where the graduate satisfies the immigration authorities that he or she has taken appropriate steps to access suitable graduate level employment [1].

Note: The sources do not specify the duration of permission for a Level 9 masters degree specifically, but rather for awards at Level 9 or above in general.

case.question: What does Stamp 1G allow me to do

result.question: What does Stamp 1G allow me to do
result.answer: You can work full time in accordance with employment law requirements [1]. You are not permitted to operate a business or be self-employed [4]. If you wish to continue working after Stamp 1G expires, you must find a job that requires an employment permit and then follow the usual application process [1].

case.question: What is Stamp 0

result.question: What is Stamp 0
result.answer: Stamp 0 indicates permission to stay in Ireland for a temporary period, subject to conditions [2]. You must be of independent means, fully financially self-sufficient or have a sponsor who can support you fully [2]. You cannot receive any benefits or use publicly funded services and must have private medical insurance [2].

case.question: Can I work full time during the summer holidays on Stamp 2

result.question: Can I work full time during the summer holidays on Stamp 2
result.answer: Yes, you can work full-time during holidays with Stamp 2 [2].

case.question: How many hours can a student work per week during term time

result.question: How many hours can a student work per week during term time
result.answer:
Students with a valid Stamp 2 permission may work up to 20 hours a week while studying in Ireland [2]. During the months of June, July, August and September and from 15 December to 15 January students may work up to 40 hours per week [2].

However, if the internship/placement forms an integral part of an academic course listed on the ILEP, students may work more than 20 hours per week in these placements/internships [1].

case.question: What documents do I need to bring to my first registration appointment

result.question: What documents do I need to bring to my first registration appointment
result.answer:
You will need to provide a full list of required documents depending on the type of permission being registered, which can be found here [1]. For Stamp 2A Registrations and Renewals, you will need to bring:
- The biometric page of your current valid passport(s) [5]
- A letter from your college/school confirming your enrolment as a student [5]
- Proof that you have paid college/school fees [5]
- Private Medical Insurance or Travel Insurance with medical cover for accidents and medical incident including hospital stays in Ireland, valid for 12 months, or if less than 12 months – for the duration of your stay [3, 5]
- Proof of your exam results [5]

case.question: How do I renew my IRP card

result.question: How do I renew my IRP card
result.answer: You can apply to renew your IRP card up to 12 weeks prior to its expiry date [2]. You must currently be present in Ireland to be eligible to renew your permission to remain online and accept a declaration confirming this when applying [2]. To renew, select the Registration (IRP Card) Renewals form on the online portal, read and accept the declaration and data privacy notice, complete the required personal information, and enter details from your current valid passport [4].

case.question: How much does the Critical Skills Employment Permit cost

result.question: How much does the Critical Skills Employment Permit cost
result.answer: The processing fee for a Critical Skills Employment Permit is €1,000 [1]. If an application is unsuccessful, 90% of the fee will be refunded to the applicant [1].

case.question: What is the minimum salary for a critical skills permit if I graduated recently

result.question: What is the minimum salary for a critical skills permit if I graduated recently
result.answer: If you have received your qualification within the 12 month period prior to the date of application for the employment permit, the minimum annual remuneration will be €36,848 [2].

case.question: How long do I have to stay with my first employer on a critical skills permit

result.question: How long do I have to stay with my first employer on a critical skills permit
result.answer: You must stay with your initial employer for at least 9 months [1]. However, if you are made redundant, you can change employers after 4 weeks of notification and within 6 months from the date of dismissal by reason of redundancy [2], [4].

case.question: What happens if I am made redundant while on a critical skills permit

result.question: What happens if I am made redundant while on a critical skills permit
result.answer:
If you are made redundant while on a Critical Skills Employment Permit, you must notify the Employment Permits Section within 4 weeks of your dismissal [1]. You will then have up to 6 months from the date of dismissal by reason of redundancy to seek alternative employment [2]. If you cannot acquire another job within this period, you must contact the immigration authorities to establish your immigration status beyond that period [3].

If you obtain a subsequent 2-year job offer with the same job title, a Critical Skills Employment Permit application will still be considered [2].

case.question: When can I move from Stamp 1 to Stamp 4 with a critical skills permit

result.question: When can I move from Stamp 1 to Stamp 4 with a critical skills permit
result.answer: You must have been in employment in the State for a minimum of 21 months on the basis of a Critical Skills Employment Permit and/or Hosting Agreement [2,5]. You can apply directly to the Dept of Justice for a Stamp 4 without needing a renewal permit through the Department of Enterprise, Tourism and Employment [1].

case.question: Can my spouse work in Ireland if I hold a critical skills permit

result.question: Can my spouse work in Ireland if I hold a critical skills permit
result.answer: Yes, once your dependants/partners/spouses are resident in the State, they are eligible to seek any employment [1]. They can also apply for a Dependant/Partner/Spouse Employment Permit, which is currently issued free of charge [1].

case.question: How soon after arriving in Ireland do I have to register my permission

result.question: How soon after arriving in Ireland do I have to register my permission
result.answer: You must register your permission within 90 days of receiving a landing stamp in your passport [1]. You can book an appointment as soon as possible after you arrive and create an account on the Customer Service Portal [4]. Appointments should only be booked after you receive an instruction to register, on arrival in the State [5].
